packageRules.description: Group all non-major devDependency updates into a single PR to reduce review churn.

Auto-merge is DISABLED until branch protection exists. It was briefly enabled on the reasoning that 'tests are now a required CI step' — that reasoning was wrong. The checks run, but nothing REQUIRES them: the default branch of this public repository has no protection, no required status checks, and no required review. Unattended merge into an unprotected default branch is how a compromised build-tooling release reaches the repo with no human in the loop. Re-enable only after required status checks are configured; see the enablement order in the pull request that introduced this file.
Group GitHub Actions digest updates; the repository pins every action by SHA.
Keep the Trigger.dev SDK, build package, and CLI on the same version. Mismatched versions across these three break the worker build.
Keep Next.js and its ESLint config aligned.
Keep React and its types aligned.
Major upgrades are never auto-merged; they require review and an explicit decision.
Let new releases settle before proposing them, to avoid churn on immediately-patched versions.
